targets.presence: Is a distinct floor rug or loose floor mat visible in `photo`? Do not count fitted wall-to-wall carpet.
targets.region: The smallest box around a distinct floor rug or loose floor mat nearest the camera in `photo`. Include only its visible extent.

targets.presence: Are at least two separate floor rugs or loose mats visible in `photo`? Do not count parts of the same rug twice.
targets.region: The smallest box around the separate floor rug or mat farthest from the camera in `photo`. Include only its visible extent.

targets.presence: Is a low footstool or ottoman visible in `photo`? Do not count chairs, tables, or cabinets.
targets.region: The smallest box around the low footstool or ottoman nearest the camera in `photo`. Include only its visible extent.

targets.presence: Is an exposed electrical cable lying on the floor visible in `photo`? Do not count plumbing, railings, or furniture legs.
targets.region: The smallest box around an exposed electrical cable lying on the floor in `photo`. Include only its visible extent.
